author.headline: Don’t just link in - Beam in.

comments.text:
Plus auto have done this myself by the time I correct all the AI errors.

Auto-complete without telepathy is auto-bad-or-lucky guess.

Auto-search without auto-corroborate is a rumor mill or an hallucination waiting to happen.

I don't hate AI, but I don't love how often it disappoints me.
